NOTE
**Close**

The author replaced the screenshot links in the description with public URLs and added two Before/After pairs. There was no new push, and none was needed for this feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Precise Before/After screenshots are now in the description (rows with avatars, and text-only slash-command rows), but I couldn't open the links to check them |
| ❌  | The linked issue #37030 no longer has "help wanted"; it was removed on 2026-09-04 because the work "requires discussion" |
| ❌  | The author has no merged PRs, and this PR doesn't continue a "completion candidate" PR |
| ℹ️  | The plan the PR "follows" on #37030 has no maintainer reply, so no one approved it |

###### Next step

Close the PR, since the issue is not open to contributors, with `gh pr close 40085`.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the PR and the screenshots. We're closing this because #37030 no longer has the "help wanted" label (it was removed as the approach needs discussion), and we only accept contributor PRs for issues with that label.
```
